title: Diagonalizable operators and annihilating polynomials
objectives: Prove that eigenspaces of distinct eigenvalues are independent
Construct the minimal polynomial and prove its properties
Prove the distinct-linear-factor criterion in both directions
prerequisites: Chapters 8, 9 and 12: operator spaces, similarity and eigenvalues.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 25 and 26 were read in full; the second matrix, the converse proof by Lagrange polynomials and the exercises are original.
